classification: preregistered conservative-profile comparison of the existing macro-quality A sleeve; no new factor

gates.D1: all three variants complete full 2x, recent fresh starts and full 3x
gates.G5_recent: 2025-10-14 fresh-start return >0 and recent five-start mean >0

known_limitations: A sleeve standalone concentration failed C2-C4 in R266.
No new alpha; this is a risk-profile comparison of an existing sleeve.
R40 local snapshot and canonical data drift remain unresolved.
Longer holding period and macro gates can make the curve look smoother without proving deployability.
question: 在双袖候选年度体验偏弱的情况下，单独的 A 腿宏观质量策略，或给 A 腿叠加 12%/15% 无杠杆波动率目标，能否提供更稳定的年度持有体验，作为低收益、低回撤备选？
selection_rule: If multiple variants pass G1-G7, choose the one with the highest bootstrap positive rate, tie-break by annual return. This is a conservative-profile candidate only; A sleeve concentration is already known to fail C2-C4, so it cannot be promoted to production without a separate concentration fix.

variants.A_raw: A sleeve at 100% of its backtest exposure; no additional volatility target
variants.A_vol12: A sleeve with 60d 12% annual volatility target, exposure bounds [0.2,1.0], monthly
variants.A_vol15: A sleeve with 60d 15% annual volatility target, exposure bounds [0.2,1.0], monthly
